policy: Version 2.1.0 of the engineering memory policy: everything 2.0.0 requires, plus the rule that a lesson's prose records the residual limit of its control and never contradicts its status. Every GUARDED lesson names a registered guardrail, every control and evidence reference is resolved against the repository, and every lesson provenance locator must resolve against the checkpoint it cites. The guardrail registry lives at the fixed path .iacode/memory/guardrails/registry.json, resolved by lessons.guardrail_registry_path and by nothing else; this file declares no relocatable path, because a configuration key that no code reads is a defect rather than documentation. A memory without this file is read under the 1.0.0 rules, which is how sealed checkpoints stay valid under their own version.
